title: Puzzle header
description: A pinned two-tier header: a lavender announcement strip with a bold lead-in, a link and a close cross, over a powder nav bar with a green-tiled wordmark, chevroned menu links that turn violet on hover, an ink demo button, a soft violet trial button and a sign-in link. On phones: wordmark, the violet button and a burger that opens a full-width link panel.
notes: sticks to the top of the page (position: sticky), so put it directly in the page container
no JavaScript: the strip closes through a hidden checkbox, the phone menu is a native <details>
